No, that is not true. The 13th AHV pension (also called the "13th pension" or "AHV‑Bonus") is not limited to people receiving an invalidity pension. It is a one‑time bonus payment from the Old‑Age and Survivors' Insurance (AHV) that is automatically granted to all individuals who receive an AHV or IV (invalidity) pension.  

There is no separate application required; eligible pensioners receive the payment automatically, provided they meet the criteria (e.g., receiving an AHV or IV pension and not being subject to certain exclusions). The amount and timing of the payment are determined by the AHV administration.
